question: How does the Goddess dwell in and transmit the methods of food conduct?
premises: The Goddess abides in the mind focused on the conduct of food.
The Goddess gives the methods of the conduct of food.
inference: The Goddess inwardly abides in and outwardly imparts the discipline of food conduct.
plain_english: She abides in the mind devoted to the conduct of food and gives the methods of that conduct.
